description: An engine alert the Windows app shows as a notification. The app names the folder in the engine's environment; the engine writes one file per alert there (backend/tracker/osnotify.py), and the app takes, shows and deletes them (RoleBand.EngineHost/EngineAlerts.cs). backend/tests/test_osnotify.py and the native EngineAlertTests both read this file.
